title: Chapter 526
paragraphs: Chapter 526
Episode 144. For a Friend (4)
Thud!
Kevin's body crashed onto the ground, causing a dull noise. He convulsed a few times before he breathed his last.
His last ultimatum to accept the Emperor's edict became his last words.
The vanguard commander who came to attack Gwamhwangseong was met with death by a single stroke.
The Emperor's vanguard could not take their eyes off Kevin's corpse for a while. It was hard to accept his death even after seeing it with their own eyes.
It wasn't because many of them admired Kevin on a regular basis, or they had deep ties with him.
More than 90% of the vanguard could not understand why Kevin had died.
'What just happened?'
'Did the commander really die?'
The moment the ordinary knights were puzzled, there was another flash of light from the wall of Gwamhwangseong.
The second sword energy, wider than the first, cut off both wings of the red dragon, leaving a luminous trail in the sky.
[Kyaaaaak-!]
Only after the red dragon also lost its wings and crashed to the ground, the vanguard realized that it was Dante's sword energy that killed Kevin.
"Did the dragon not hear my words? I told you not to dare look down on Gwamhwangseong."
His voice seemed to be speaking quietly, but the energized voice spread all over the plain.
Now, all those who looked down on Gwamhwangseong were gone. Instead, Dante looked down on all the vanguard from the wall.
It was then that the vanguard could feel it.
They realized that the place they had come to attack was Gwamhwangseong.
At the eerie realization, the ordinary knights stiffened all at once. Some instinctive fear stemming from the name 'Hyiran' was pricking their brains.
"From that distance... he shot the sword energy? With this speed and power?"
When Skat Hollow of the Central Knights Division spoke, the other key knights nodded their heads as if they were disgusted.
"It's not a joke, he is indeed the successor of Gwamhwang."
"Dante Hyiran. I always remember him being dignified and gentle, but seeing him now, he really is a beast..."
Not only the ordinary knights but also the commanders felt a chill down their spines.
Dante had been one of the most famous people in the Empire from an early age because he was confirmed as the junior lord of Hyiran, skipping generations.

From the moment he became the junior lord, all sorts of rumors followed Dante. His small physique, which did not seem like a natural warrior at all, his weak physical strength, and his delicate face made people doubt Dante.
In addition, Dante did not participate in the Empire's swordsmanship tournament very often. Most of them were private duels, so there weren't many people who knew Dante's real skills.
But those who saw Dante's sword, those who saw his growth rate even once, all said the same thing.
"The successor to the world's number one sword is pretty much decided."
Chilling silence was filling the air, with only the screams of the fallen Red Dragon echoing throughout the plains.
Magicians desperately performed healing magic to try to reattach its wings, but it was insufficient.
"I am Dante Hairan, the heir of Hairan and the acting lord of Sword Emperor City. The Imperial Army should state its reason for visiting Sword Emperor City again, with respect."
Scott Hollow stepped forward.

"I am Scott Hollow of the Central Knights Division! Sir Dante, please don’t do this. You're heading down an irreversible path. His Majesty has ordered the war to cease as soon as Hairan returns the white stone!"
"There's no such thing as that stone, Sir Scott Hollow. Even if there was, the Emperor cannot treat Hairan like this."
"Sir Dante! There is still a chance. As a warrior who has always admired Hairan, I hope that Sword Emperor City will return to the people and His Majesty!"

"Opportunity? Are you really saying that you don’t understand the Emperor's intent to break the pillar of the Empire, blinded by power? If so, then I'll give you one last chance. Immediately drop your swords and surrender. If you do, I will spare all of you. But if you knowingly participate in the Emperor's scheme......”
As Dante gathered his energy, he trailed off.
"Those who point a sword at Hairan will not survive, not even one. The fact that you're just following orders won't serve as any excuse. You are all... knights."
One could not afford to be lax when facing a thousand knights, let alone ordinary people.
Rather, the sooner he annihilated them before the main forces arrived, the less troublesome the next battle would be.
From the moment the Emperor's purge began, Dante was prepared.
For his own death, and for driving others to death. Even if he had to kill thousands, tens of thousands, or even more, Dante had no intention of stopping before the Emperor.
‘Damn, I didn’t know about Sir Ron, but I thought Dante Hairan would at least give a chance for dialogue. This is a dead end. Is he choosing annihilation…….’
Just then.
One of the common knights standing in the ranks dropped his sword to the ground.
Clank!
Everyone turned their heads towards him.
“I... I can't fight against Hairan. If Hairan hadn't intervened in the Shuka battle, our family would have been completely annihilated."
"What is this nonsense...!"
Clank, clang!
Like a flame spreading through oil-soaked paper, the common knights were dropping their swords to the ground.
"I also can't fight against Hairan. I was an orphan, and I could become a knight because of Hairan’s knight scholarship."
"I also received a scholarship from Hairan…”
"I too owe a debt to Hairan…"
More than half of the common knights dropped their swords like this. It all happened in less than a minute.
"Pick up your swords immediately!"
"Do these lunatics think they can survive after defying His Majesty's command!"
The commanders of the vanguard were speechless at the sudden turn of events. The common knights who had dropped their swords even knelt down.
With a single strike, Dante took out the commander, and with a few words, completely demoralized the vanguard.
Scott, Marvin, Gloria, Roya, and other commanders had never imagined this scenario.
They didn't know what to do, alternately looking at the knights who had dropped their swords and Sword Emperor City.
'Damn it!'
Scott gritted his teeth.
He knew better than anyone else that if the main force arrived and saw this situation, not only the common knights but even the commanders would face more than just simple punishment.
Swish-!
Scott struck at the neck of a common knight who had dropped his sword. He had made his decision.
"We have traitors among us, what a disgrace! Those who have dropped their swords will be executed immediately!"
The knights of Sword Emperor City hadn't even drawn their swords yet, but fountains of blood were springing up all over the camp of the Emperor's vanguard.
The knights who had dropped their swords did not resist. Therefore, it was hard for the vanguard soldiers killing them to suppress their feelings of discomfort.
"You idiots, what do you think will change by doing this? When the main force arrives, it’s the end of Sword Emperor City anyway…!"
In fact, the commanders of the vanguard had been uneasy since they first came here.
Kevin of the Dragon King Knights Division was not competent and reputable enough to serve as a commander, and most of the thousand common knights were those who had received Hairan's favor.
And what was the result?
Kevin Ferrell, who had stepped forward like a thunderbolt, met his death, and the common knights were offering their necks, refusing to fight.
As the situation reached this point, the commanders couldn't shake off the feeling that the Emperor's intentions had been hidden in the initial troop composition and commander selection.
"Damn it, pick up your swords…!"
Already about fifty common knights had been beheaded.
The vanguard commanders and the remaining sergeants who hadn't dropped their swords were almost losing their minds.
The phrase "it's too late to turn back" seemed more fitting for them, not for Sword Emperor City.
"Sword Emperor City!"
As Dante shouted, the knights who had been waiting in the city all climbed up the city walls in unison.
"We are rescuing those who have not forgotten the grace of Hairan. Cut down all those who stand in your way."
As soon as the command fell, the knights on the walls threw themselves onto the plains.

At the same time, the castle gates opened and knights poured out from there as well. Those who emerged from the gate appeared to be in charge of breakthrough, while those who leaped down took on the role of encirclement, and formations were quickly formed.
Just as Dante was about to join them, Shuras Helter grabbed his shoulder.
"Your Grace, do not go out. The main force will arrive soon, so you should conserve your energy. Besides the Five Sword Saints, you're the only one who can handle the top knights of the main force."
Both physically and mentally.

Dante was barely maintaining his composure. He wanted to rush in immediately at the sight of those who remembered Hairan's grace being killed in front of his eyes, but he was born frail and had already been exhausted since the meeting.
And Dante was currently the strongest knight and acting lord of Sword Emperor City, along with the Five Sword Saints, who were the trusted confidants of Ron.
"…Understood."
The Five Sword Saints of Hairan were not currently in Sword Emperor City.
If they all safely return and Dante can fight at his best, there is hope. All the knights of Sword Emperor City thought so.
Instead of Dante, half of the lords of the thirty families threw themselves to the ground.
The battle with the vanguard was flowing towards a one-sided victory for Hairan. There were dragons, magicians, and war equipment, but the number of knights was too different.

However, since the knights of Hairan were moving with the primary goal of rescuing the common knights who had dropped their swords, rather than annihilation, the subjugation was not carried out very quickly.

Hairan currently lacked a standout knight who could dominate the battlefield and swing the situation, so this tendency was stronger. It would be instant if Dante took on that role, but considering the main force, Shuras's judgment was right a hundred times over.
"Glory to Hairan!"
"Don't dare to mention honor, dogs of the Emperor!"
By the time the sunset was almost gone, the subjugation was nearing its end.
All that was left were a few main knights, a dragon, and about ten magicians, including Roya.
On the other hand, Hairan had only lost five knights. Over a hundred common knights who had dropped their swords were rescued, and the battle with the vanguard was truly a complete victory.
However, by then, the knights guarding the side and back gates of Sword Emperor City had confirmed the appearance of the Emperor's main force from afar.
"The Emperor's main force is approaching!"
"About twenty Emperor-class cannons confirmed! We will activate the defense equipment!"
In addition to the side and back gates, reinforcements from the Emperor's main force were also arriving beyond the main gate.
The report from the commanders that the main force was at least ten times the size of the vanguard turned out to be true.
The number of knights closing in to besiege Sword Emperor City seemed to far exceed ten thousand at first glance.
"…Rescue operation over, we will now commence the annihilation operation."
Dante said, looking at the newly appearing enemies.
